toegepas.voor: Stel jou 'n pad van 200 meter voor van twee miljoen jaar gelede tot vandag.
toegepas.na: Stel jou 'n pad van 200 meter voor wat van twee miljoen jaar gelede tot vandag strek.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The time span dangles after the separable verb particle 'voor'; a relative clause with 'strek' ties it to the road.
toegepas.fout: The time span trails after the separable particle 'voor' and hangs loose from 'pad'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The relative clause with 'strek' ties the span to the road and removes the stumble without changing the meaning.

laat_vaar.na: Van die oudste tot die jongste
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'van ... tot' with the articles is the natural Afrikaans form; 'van oudste na jongste' echoes English 'from oldest to youngest'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Van oudste na jongste' follows the natural Afrikaans ordering pattern (cf. 'van klein na groot'), so the change is lateral.

laat_vaar.voor: die koms van boere met yster
laat_vaar.na: die koms van boere wat yster gebruik het
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'boere met yster' is compressed and can attach to the wrong phrase; a short relative clause is clearer for Grade 5.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Embedding 'wat yster gebruik het' before 'op hul eie manier bly leef' stacks verbs mid-sentence and makes it harder for a Grade 5 reader.

na_skrywer.blok: Die tyd voordat mense geskryf het
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The point is that no written sources come FROM that time; 'oor' (about) is imprecise, since later writings about it exist.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Oor daardie tyd' can be read as 'about that time', yet later written accounts about prehistory do exist.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Swapping 'oor' (about) for 'uit' (from) changes what the sentence claims, so the writer must decide the wording even though the imprecision is real.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: toe baie van mense se gereedskap van klip was
na_skrywer.na: toe mense baie van hul gereedskap van klip gemaak het
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'baie van mense se gereedskap' is clumsy; making 'mense' the subject reads naturally and keeps 'baie van'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'baie van mense se gereedskap' is clumsy.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so the writer must handle it.

vlae.teks: Jagter-versamelaars het wilde diere gejag en wilde plante versamel.
vlae.rede: The decided definition of 'jagter-versamelaar' deliberately uses 'veldkos' instead of 'wilde plante', because plants alone make the word narrower than the truth (honey, eggs, insects, shellfish); this study sentence uses the rejected wording. Swapping it widens the meaning, so it is for the writer, not a language edit.
